about: Step 1 of the card consolidation: the plan only. Nothing on the site changes until a merge below is carried out. files and pages in each merge are counted by count.mjs, never typed.

targets.name: card
targets.job: A framed box that holds content: a title, a few lines, a number, a link to somewhere.
classes: --card-edge (a status colour on the leading edge)
a.card (the whole box is a link)
targets.rule: A framed box pads by --pad-card, which scales with the box itself, so a narrow card and a wide one both look right; its children get --gap between them for free.
targets.draw: div.c('card', () => { h3('A card'); p('A heading and a line. No other CSS.'); });

targets.name: frame
targets.job: A framed box whose contents touch its edge: a picture, a table, a list of rows, or a head and a foot bar around a body.
targets.rule: A frame pads nothing itself; its parts share one inline inset, --pad-card, so the words in the head, the body and the foot line up.
targets.draw: div.c('surface', () => { div.c('ui-panel-head h4', 'Head'); div.c('ui-panel-body', () => p('The body pads like a card.')); div.c('ui-panel-foot flex gap reverse', () => { button.c('prim', 'Save'); button('Cancel'); }); });

targets.name: region
targets.job: A band of the page itself: a section, a title strip, a tab's pane, with or without a ground of its own.
targets.rule: A page region pads by --pad, which scales with the page; its background may bleed to the edge of the screen, its text never does.
targets.draw: div.c('wash pad', () => { h3('A region'); p('A band of the page, padded by the page.'); });

targets.name: preview
targets.job: A picture of a child page on its parent's index: a thumbnail above a title.
targets.rule: A preview is a picture of another page: the thumbnail carries the frame, so the preview itself pads nothing.
targets.draw: div.c('page-previews', () => div.c('page-preview', () => { a.c('page-preview-link', () => span.c('page-preview-title', 'Child page')).href('#'); p.c('page-preview-desc', 'One sentence about the page.'); }));

targets.name: pill
targets.job: A small rounded label: a status, a count, a tag, a link to a task.
targets.rule: A pill is a label the size of its text, so it pads in its own em and never by a page or card word.
targets.draw: div.c('flex wrap gap-35', () => { span.c('ui-pill', 'core'); span.c('ui-pill ui-badge accent', 'shipped'); span.c('ui-pill ui-badge count', '3'); });

targets.name: row
targets.job: One line in a list, on its parent's ground: a message, an inbox entry, a setting.
new_classes: .ui-row — owned by a new ui/row template
new_rules: .ui-row { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.6em; min-width: 0; padding: 0.45em 0.6em; border-radius: var(--radius); }
targets.rule: A row is one line in a list: it pads in its own em, takes a ground only when hovered or selected, and never draws a border of its own.
targets.draw: div.c('flex v', () => { div.c('ui-row', () => { icon('mail'); span.c('flex-1', 'A row'); span.c('muted', 'now'); }); div.c('ui-row selected', () => { icon('mail'); span.c('flex-1', 'A selected row'); span.c('muted', '2m'); }); });

targets.name: fold
targets.job: A row that opens: a question and its answer, a bar over a hidden body.
targets.rule: A fold is a row that opens: its summary pads like a row, and what opens under it keeps the row's inset.
targets.draw: details.c('ui-accordion-item', $d => { $d.el.open = true; summary('A question'); p('Its answer, on the same inset.'); });

targets.name: popover
targets.job: A box that floats over the page, anchored to what opened it: a menu, a tooltip, a toast.
targets.rule: A floating box holds controls, so it pads in its own em like a control, never by the page it floats over.

merges.title: The ui/ templates wear .card
merges.also: The two inner boxes of the course viewer.
merges.risk_why: Template pages that draw fixed sample content; no live data, no other team edits them.
merges.visible_change: Measured live at 1920, each drawn in a box 30rem wide — stat tile: first word 17px → 19px from the left edge, 17px → 17px from the top; height 123px → 135px; alert: first word 19px → 19px from the left edge, 17px → 21px from the top; height 63px → 63px; toolbar: first word 31px → 33px from the left edge, 26px → 26px from the top; height 72px → 72px.

merges.title: Link tiles become a.card
merges.risk_why: Two labs in /imagine/ and their verbatim copies under layouts/labs; each class is used only where it is defined.
merges.visible_change: Measured live at 1920, each drawn in a box 30rem wide — decks card: first word 15px → 19px from the left edge, 18px → 21px from the top; height 101px → 116px; blog card: first word 18px → 19px from the left edge, 20px → 21px from the top; height 109px → 116px.
